task_description.overview: Detect seismic event onsets using the recursive STA/LTA algorithm for continuous real-time processing.
steps: Load waveform data into a Trace object.
Apply on_threshold and off_threshold to cft.
Extract trigger intervals for each continuous segment.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Given seismic samples in {waveform_data_path}, compute the recursive STA/LTA characteristic with STA window of {STA_seconds}s and LTA window of {LTA_seconds}s. Detect on/off trigger times using thresholds {on_threshold} and {off_threshold}. Output trigger sample intervals. Plot a figure to show the waveform, the recursive sta/lta caculated result, and the finally picked onset and offset times. Save the 1D array trigger_cft series to {trigger_cft} and the plot to {trigger_plot}.
